description: Fast, native file search engine and launcher: name search, content search, and a daemon behind both
post_install: info 'rgy: READ THIS. Scoop does not start the search daemon.'
info '  If you do nothing: the rgxy launcher says ''no connection to the daemon'', and'
info '  a searchctl query can be up to 30 minutes out of date (its index is a snapshot).'
info '  Pick ONE way to keep the index current:'
info '  A) daemon (recommended, resident, live change feed):  rgy-autostart install'
info '     the same action is install.ps1 -Activate (no download, re-runnable). Undo: rgy-autostart uninstall'
info '  B) one-shot snapshot (no resident process):  searchctl --root $env:USERPROFILE --reindex --count ''*'''
info '     rebuilds the index ONCE; repeat it (or schedule it daily) to refresh.'
info '  Both write the same index file, so do not run both. See the README.'
